title: Synthetic beginner editing practice notes
content: Synthetic learning demo guidance: Beginner video editing can be approached as a sequence of small decisions. A learner may practise trimming a clip, arranging a simple sequence, checking the timing, adding readable text, and reviewing the result before sharing it. Jia Wei's fictional teaching style encourages clear steps, patient repetition, and useful feedback rather than perfection. These notes are general learning guidance, not professional training advice and not a record of a real creator's teaching history.
